gen-gf-snowburst-one-fs-fira-sans: Snowburst One cuts its letters like a stencil sheet, tall and bold. Fira Sans does the quieter job, drawing every curve with no swing in weight and a generous x-height that makes a plain sans easy to follow.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-fs-amulya: Amulya keeps the gaps in its curves generous and modern, giving text a lightness that the heavier heading never tries for. Balsamiq Sans earns its keep big and brief.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-fs-plein: Plein feels reliable and clean, with a clear channel leading into each round letter on the page. And Balsamiq Sans brings a rope-like consistency to every stem, bowl and tail, which is where the two differ most.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-fs-spline-sans: Bold and expressive, Balsamiq Sans lays down a stencil-cut channel of constant weight with no pinched curves anywhere. Spline Sans is its approachable counterpart, with wide gaps between curve ends and stems that give the pair its friendliest quality.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-fs-synonym: Balsamiq Sans draws a stencil-cut channel of constant weight, bold and expressive, with no tight pinched curves. But Synonym is the one to enlarge a notch if the sans-serif text feels dense, since its generous curve openings reward the extra size.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-outfit: Outfit reads clean and approachable, its curves finishing well before they close, like cable bent into shapes. Outfit sits under Balsamiq Sans, whose bold stencil-cut channel makes the headline loud while the text stays friendly.
gen-gf-baumans-fs-amulya: Wrench-wide and unmistakably bold, Baumans draws every stroke at one thickness, with no hairlines at all. Amulya follows in a modern plain sans, its generous curve gaps giving the text room to breathe under that blunt heading.
gen-gf-baumans-fs-chillax: Chillax reads casual and relaxed, its line like spaghetti laid out in letters, with pen-lifted curves leaving each loop unfinished. A long page of it would feel loose and easygoing, nothing like Baumans.
gen-gf-baumans-fs-plein: Baumans opens its c like a crescent wrench, wide and commanding. Plein gives each round letter a clear channel in, so enlarge it slightly and its sans-serif clarity sits firmly against that heading.
gen-gf-baumans-fs-spline-sans: Spline Sans feels contemporary and approachable, with wide gaps between curve ends and stems under the commanding Baumans. Spline Sans keeps vertical and horizontal strokes at identical weight, so a longer passage would read smoothly and without fuss.
